# Pinned-fetches allowlist for projectbluefin/actions reusable-pinned-fetches
# (projectbluefin/utah#902, Option A).
#
# One entry per line. A bare rule id disables that rule; any other line
# suppresses one finding whose printed text contains it. Lines starting with
# '#' are comments. Every entry below is a reviewed non-fetch or a reference
# the suite is handed by its caller, not a tool this repository downloads.

# The image under test is an input: the caller (an image repository's gate or
# a manual dispatch) chooses the ref, usually a digest, and the suite boots or
# `bootc switch`es the VM to exactly that. The suite verifies the image; it
# does not fetch a tool from it.
inputs.target-image
Full OCI ref to upgrade TO
Pre-stage target image via bootc switch
OCI image to test (e.g.
Full OCI image reference (e.g.
default: "ghcr.io/projectbluefin/bluefin:latest"
Target OCI image to bootc switch to
Run bootc switch to target image
sudo bootc switch '${TARGET_IMAGE}'
bootc switch completed
after bootc switch + reboot

# Justfile local recipes name the stream a developer wants to run the suite
# against on their own machine; nothing from CI consumes these lines.
"ghcr.io/ublue-os/bluefin:latest"
"ghcr.io/ublue-os/bluefin-dx:latest"
"ghcr.io/ublue-os/bluefin-nvidia:latest"

# Harness image built in the same job and never pulled from a registry.
localhost/gnomeos-harness:canary

# String normalisation of a user-supplied ref before a registry query, not a
# download (update-v1-tag.yml).
NAME="${NAME}:latest"

# Shallow clone immediately followed by `git fetch`/`git checkout` of the
# committed SELENIUM_AT_SPI_SHA and a `git rev-parse HEAD` comparison that
# aborts on mismatch (scripts/install-kde-webdriver.sh).
git clone --quiet --depth 1 "${SELENIUM_AT_SPI_URL}"
